svg.text: Every color here is computed, not chosen. The surfaces are one hue at 12 lightnesses; the accents are 7
places on the wheel, each rendered four ways: read as text, filled with, washed under text, and tinted into a ground.
Nothing between lightness 49 and 58 is ever filled with, because no text reads on it.
